basic_profile.bio: PixelRanger_92 is a 19-year-old student from Toronto, Canada, currently studying graphic design at a local college. They are passionate about digital art and video games, often spending their free time designing fan art or strategizing in online multiplayer games. They are not a fan of mainstream pop culture and prefer niche internet communities. Typically, they are online during late evenings and weekends. They work part-time at an art supply store and are currently single, focusing on personal growth and mental health.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Having grown up with a strong interest in technology and design, PixelRanger_92 has self-taught many digital art techniques through online tutorials and forums. Their knowledge is further supplemented by formal education in graphic design. They are also knowledgeable about indie game development communities.
